title: Business is a race: how to outrun your competitors
excerpt: Competition has led to innovation in business. Since business owners have been looking for different ways of being unique and accepted by customers, should you decide to start a business, a study o…

sections.heading: Overview
body: Competition has led to innovation in business. Since business owners have been looking for different ways of being unique and accepted by customers, should you decide to start a business, a study of your biggest competition, becomes essential. It gives an insight not only into that particular company or organization but into the industry segment as a whole as well.

Things to look for are: how has he achieved a space in the minds of your consumer? Where and when does your competitor locate these prospective clients? What unique selling (or buying) point are they offering? How do they interact and engage with their existing users? And so on…

Although the word ‘competition’ tends to come with a negative connotation, it depends entirely on the viewpoint you choose to take. For instance, you could either enter the loop of competing with an organization by comparing yourself to them, or by learning from them.

Our personal understanding (and with numbers to back up) is that there is a huge market out there. The ratio of demand and supply is always see-sawing, and it is the one who acts fast, that stays in the lead. On that note, if you look at the concept of the competition once again, things will seem different. All your research could help you understand what it is that you are offering that is different from them. It could direct you towards finalizing your tone of language be it direct, conversational, or include an element of fiction via storytelling.
Healthy competition is favourable to facilitate innovation and expansion of the horizons of doing business and growing together. Here are 4 ways in which you could use competition to your advantage:

• Make things convenient: Every time a consumer or prospective consumer for your product or service comes in touch with your brand, it is important that they experience a seamless interaction. Things like a slow loading speed on the website, or images that do not load in time, and so on are minor but immensely critical things to keep in mind while interacting with your consumers. Do not let them become a road block to your business and brand.

• Generating a USP: A market that is loaded with products with a bare minimum difference of just the name gives consumers enough options to choose from. Having a distinct USP would keep you a step ahead, ensuring that decisions that others take (especially from a price perspective), do not impact you as a business.

• Deliver Value: With changing times, the need for new products arises. As a business, it is imperative to have a macro vision of providing what your consumers need so that you can deliver true value to them when they need it.

• Keep innovating: Getting consumer attention could be an easy task at first glance. However, with everyone vying for the attention of the same target audience, innovation in your communication strategy can help you sustain the attention of your target audience.
• Care for customers: For the long term, business-consumer relationship, genuine care and concern is a must. A strong consumer support backup does the job if done correctly.

In current times, research has been given utmost importance as it is backed up by a competitor’s strategy, consumer insights, finances, and statistics. If you are a startup and are looking for ways to channelize your business, work on your research, and you have won half of your battle. Your business will attain stability as time passes by, provided you keep an eye on your competitor next door.

title: When dedicated server should be used for web hosting?
excerpt: A dedicated server is the best-suited solution for large businesses. Get dedicated hosting from MagicWorks Host, backed by 24x7 support.

sections.heading: Overview
body: We have discussed two types of web hosting until now, shared web hosting and virtual private server or VPS hosting. Each of them come with their own advantages and disadvantages. One may start with shared hosting as a novice to the online world. When the website traffic starts growing due to your efforts, you may think of shifting to a better option. In this case, VPS is the answer. VPS hosting can perform better than shared hosting. However, if your web site and business become more popular then you may have to choose to migrate to what is called dedicated server hosting.

In the first two types of web hosting, the physical server is always shared among number of clients. With dedicated server hosting that is not the case. The server is completely dedicated to you. There is no sharing at all.

You have full control over all the resources like processor time, memory, hard disk space, and bandwidth. You can decide on the architecture, operating system, appliances like load balancer, etc. Obviously, it comes at a high cost as compared to any other hosting plan.

Normally, dedicated server hosting comes with the best hardware, managed services, and 24×7 support. And, your website is like king. There is no chance to have any scalability problem or load time issue.

sections.heading: Pros
body: • A completely dedicated server for your website.
• You can decide almost everything including operating system, any additional appliances etc.
• Very fast as all 100% resources are available for the website.
• As there is no sharing, there is no chance of getting affected due to neighboring website overload.
• More secure than shared or VPS hosting. Dedicated server is completely isolated and is not affected because of the security loop hole in the neighboring website.
• This being the most expensive web hosting, the provider would give 24X7 service to you on priority basis.

sections.heading: Cons
body: • It is the most expensive option.
• As you own the entire server, you need technical expertise available to install, configure, maintain and optimize the server.
• If there is not enough traffic as you expected, dedicated server capacity can lie idle.

sections.heading: When to go for dedicated server
body: Dedicated server is the best suited solution for large businesses. The websites which receive traffic over 4 to 5 lac visitors per month. One of the important consideration is that you need to have a good technical staff to manage the server operations. You may go for dedicated hosting if security is one of the top concerns for you.

title: What is VPS web hosting?
excerpt: VPS hosting more affordable as compared to dedicated hosting. This would make the cost of VPS affordable. VPS is recommended for fast growing websites.

sections.heading: Overview
body: Choosing from various web hosting plans filled with offers and confusing terminology. Many times marketers use the technical terms to oversell things. Fact of the matter is that it is seldom clear what exactly is being offered. That is why, comparing the features and facilities from various providers at a given price point and choosing the best suitable becomes more arduous task. To help navigate this jungle of terminology, today we will talk about VPS hosting in more details.

VPS stands for virtual private server. Here, a physical server is taken and virtualization software is installed on it. Virtualization software can create many virtual server environments on a given physical server. Hence the same physical server now appears to have tens of virtual servers running. The beauty of the technology such that you can assign each of these different virtual servers to different clients. And, they will have complete control over the virtual server including the kind of operating system, software etc. Unlike shared hosting, the client becomes administrator or powerful user on the virtual server.
More affordable as compared to dedicated hosting as one do not have to pay complete price of a physical server like in case of dedicated hosting.

sections.heading: Pros
body: VPS hosting is more secure as there is good isolation between virtual environments created on the physical sever.
Since you are the administrator or root user for your virtual environment, you have complete control over the virtual server space.
VPS hosting is more scalable as compared to shared hosting type.

sections.heading: Cons
body: VPS type of hosting is costlier as compared to shared hosting.

In VPS there are only few virtual environments/servers created on one physical server as compared to shared hosting. However, there are some chances that one virtual server if gets overloaded due to traffic, may affect your website performance.

There are two types of hosting offered, one managed hosting and second unmanaged hosting. Unmanaged hosting may be little cheaper than managed hosting. If you choose unmanaged VPS hosting, it may become difficult for you to configure, host and maintain your website. Because this requires some level of technical expertise.

sections.heading: When should you go for Virtual private server or VPS hosting
body: You might have started with shared hosting for your first attempt to make your business online. After hosting your website, you must have focused on different digital marketing efforts to drive the traffic to your website. Obviously, they would include social media marketing, search engine optimization, search engine marketing, local search engine optimization etc.

All these efforts would culminate into increased traffic on your website. After a couple of months, you can switch to VPS hosting when you see increase traffic and more conversions. This would make the cost of VPS hosting affordable. VPS is recommended for fast-growing websites.

body: HTML, Java script, CSS all these code files are text. If you remove all unnecessary characters like white spaces, comments etc. which are not used for execution, the file size would reduce. sections.heading: Reduce Redirects
body: When you redirect a page, user has to wait for one more cycle of http request-response. Please reduce number of redirects or use them only when needed for a short period of time.

sections.heading: Remove render blocking java script
body: When HTML is received from the web server, the browser reads it and constructs the document object model (DOM) tree. Before rendering the page, if it encounters a script then it has to execute that script. This slows down the page load. Try to avoid page blocking Java scripts.

sections.heading: Use better fast hosting and improve response time
body: Web hosting and the choice of server resources are deciders of speed. Because web page data is rendered after all computations are done at database and web server level. Please make sure you have enough resources like hard disk space, memory etc. Shifting to a faster server would dramatically improve the speed.

sections.heading: Use content distribution network for better webpage speed
body: Firstly you should choose the hosting server location near to your maximum number of customers. If you are mainly serving Indian customers, you should get your website hosted on Indian servers. However, when your customer base starts growing to other countries, they would experience a delay if served from distant servers. Here, content distribution/delivery network or CDN is a solution to it. In CDN, multiple copies of your website contents are stored at geographically distributed locations. In this way, the web pages are delivered more reliably and fast at any corner of the world. Ask you web hosting provider to give you CDN. This would surely boost the performance at little extra cost.

sections.heading: Use of caching improves webpage speed
body: Web browsers do not request the same information like images, script files, CSS style sheets etc. every time the page is to be rendered. It caches it when all this is fetched for the first time. And uses it, for subsequent accesses. Look at your “expires” header for setting the caching period after which the content expires or to be re-fetched. When you are using an ecommerce framework on the server-side, it will come with built-in caching mechanism. WordPress also has caching plug-ins which can be used. If you have home-grown framework, then you must implement caching inside it.
Leveraging browser caching also improves user experience.

sections.heading: Optimize images
body: Images are major culprit in making the webpage slow. First make sure that images you use on the web page are of the right size. First, do not make them larger unnecessarily. Secondly, use appropriate file format like PNG or JPEG. Use tools and optimize them for the web. You can use CSS sprites and create template for frequently used images. Doing this would save you some http requests. Hence page would load faster.

sections.heading: What is Secure Socket Layer (SSL)?
body: We know that a web browser sends an http request for the web page to the web server (which your web hosting). This data being plain text, any hacker tapping this communication, will be able to take undue advantage out of it. We encrypt this communication and no one will be able to decipher its meaning.

Secure Socket Layer or SSL, is the protocol which is used a transport layer to make this happen. It encrypts the data before sending it to the other party. This makes the communication channel more secure.

sections.heading: What is https?

In such a case it’s advisable to purchase additional ram, CPU or I/O.

title: What is an SSL certificate? Fix Chrome's “Not secure” warning
excerpt: Wondering what an SSL certificate is? Learn about website security: Google Chrome warns visitors with a “Not Secure” message on sites without one.

sections.heading: Overview
body: Google sends an email warning to webmasters saying that Chrome will mark web pages starting with ‘HTTP’ as ‘Not Secure’

Beginning from October 2017, Google Chrome will warn us with “Not Secure” message on the website when we enter any data on an HTTP Page, as a next step towards strengthening our security. This is applicable on all HTTP Pages visited in Incognito mode as well.
Treatment of HTTP pages in Chrome 62

sections.heading: What does it mean for Web Owner, a Business Owner, and Webmaster??
body: In simple words, if your website is not SSL Certified then, Chrome will mark the page as “Not Secure”. It is applicable not only in incognito mode but also in regular mode for pages where a user enters any type of data. We know that a website normally has multiple pages from where you get inputs from users, it seems Chrome will show a warning for multiple types of data for example: –
• Website Search Bar
• Contact Form
• Quick Contact form
• Get a callback form and so on…

If your website is your key source to get leads or direct business, then think what impact will it create on the user’s mind when Chrome displays it as a “NOT SECURE” website, exactly when the user starts filling data?

sections.heading: Why is Chrome doing this?
body: To help users browse the web safely, Chrome indicates connection security with an icon in the address bar. Historically, Chrome has never explicitly labeled HTTP connections to be non-secure. In January 2017, Chrome began their quest to improve how Chrome communicates connection security of HTTP Pages. Currently, Chrome marks HTTP Pages as “Not Secure” if they have secured data field like password or credit card field. Beginning in October 2017, Chrome will start showing the “Not secure” warning in two additional situations which are mentioned above.

sections.heading: How to make your website more secure and avoid Chrome tagging it with “NOT SECURE” warning?
body: For Making your website more secure for visitors or users, you should buy and install SSL Certificate for your website and for that, as a prerequisite you also need to have a dedicated IP address for your website. There are a lot of different types of SSL Certificates available in the market today.

sections.heading: What is SSL Certificate?
body: SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) is the standard security technology for establishing an encrypted link between a web server and a browser. This link ensures that all data passed between the web server and browsers remain private and integral.

sections.heading: How do you get an SSL certificate?
body: • 1st Step: Host your website with a dedicated IP address. (In order to provide the best security, SSL certificates require your website to have its own dedicated IP address.)
• 2nd Step: Buy an SSL Certificate.
• 3rd Step: Install and Activate the certificate.
• 4th step: Update your site to use HTTPS protocol.
So, are you ready to make your website more secure? Act NOW!!!
